'''Kiermet''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}} who hints about an {{Item|Enigma Soul}}.

__TOC__

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | Before obtaining [[Enigma Soul]]
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRibbit&f: It's way too high.
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: Speak for yourself, I almost got it!
&e[NPC] &aRibbit&f: Oh yeah? Prove it.
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: I can't right now. Maybe next time you ask me I will.
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Obtaining [[Enigma Soul]]
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aRibbit&f: &aWOW!
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: Impressive! What a jump!
&e[NPC] &aRibbit&f: How did you manage to jump that high?
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: They're a human, dummy. That's why.
&e[NPC] &aRibbit&f: A human! No way!
}}
|-
!Condition
!Random Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" rowspan=3 | After obtaining [[Enigma Soul]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: I don't know how we'll ever reach that high.}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: One small step for frog, one giant leap for frogkind.}}
|-
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: &aMama Frog&f always said, &o"To reach great heights, you must take a leap of faith!"&f.
&e[NPC] &aKiermet&f: I always assumed she was speaking proverbially, but now I'm starting to think she was being quite literal.
}}
|}

== Trivia ==
*'''Kiermet''' is an obvious reference to [[w:Kermit the Frog|Kermit the Frog]], the protagonist of numerous [[w:The Muppets|''Muppet'']] productions.
